title: Customer identity not verified
description: Account opened for an impersonated or synthetic identity because identity was not verified against a reliable source.

title: Incomplete KYC documentation
description: Card issued with missing officially valid documents (OVD) or proof of address.

title: Forged or tampered documents accepted
description: Altered or counterfeit documents are not detected at verification.

title: PEP not identified at onboarding
description: Politically exposed person onboarded without being identified and escalated.

title: Sanctions screening miss
description: Sanctioned individual onboarded because the screening hit was missed or wrongly discounted.

title: Adverse media not screened
description: Negative news on the applicant is not considered in the onboarding decision.

title: Incorrect customer risk rating
description: Customer assigned a low AML risk rating that does not reflect occupation, geography or product.

title: EDD not performed for high-risk customers
description: High-risk customers onboarded without enhanced due diligence and senior sign-off.

title: Address not verified
description: Communication address is not verified, leading to card interception or misdelivery.

title: Duplicate customer profiles created
description: Same customer onboarded under more than one profile, breaking single-customer view and exposure limits.

title: Customer data captured incorrectly
description: Manual keying errors in name, DOB, PAN or income flow into credit and AML systems.

title: Customer data privacy breach
description: KYC images or personal data accessed or exfiltrated without authorisation during onboarding.

title: Customer consent not captured
description: Bureau pull or data processing carried out without recorded customer consent.

title: Limit assigned without income verification
description: Credit limit set before bureau check and income verification are complete.

title: Unauthorised override of KYC rejection
description: A rejected application is overridden without the required authority.

title: Onboarding SLA breach and backlog
description: Volumes exceed capacity, causing SLA breaches and pressure to shortcut checks.

title: Third-party sourcing agent misconduct
description: Direct selling agents (DSA) submit manipulated applications or mis-sell the product.

title: Video KYC record not retained
description: V-CIP session recordings or audit trails are not stored as regulations require.
